chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 108: The Buddha - A Fly Exorcism Backfires
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang leads a sutra-chanting exorcism using a Bodhisattva of flies. But when Danyangzi is seemingly defeated, a terrifying twist reveals the true monster was inside him all along.
og_title: Danyangzi's Final Trap: Chapter 108 of Dao Gui Yi Xian
